metrics.rationale: User states '尽可能完整地接收 1000–1700 nm 波段的短波红外信号' (receive 1000-1700 nm SWIR signals as completely as possible) to improve methane absorption feature SNR.
User states '尽可能反射 300–450 nm 波段的近紫外和蓝光杂散辐射' (reflect 300-450 nm UV and blue stray radiation as much as possible) to reduce solar scattering background and detector stray response.

standard.metric_rationale: These two metrics directly capture the dual-band spectral requirement: high transmission in the signal band (1000-1700 nm) for methane detection, and high reflection in the blocking band (300-450 nm) for solar background suppression. I deliberately chose mean metrics over worst_case because the user's phrasing ('尽可能完整', '尽可能反射') indicates overall band performance rather than point-wise guarantees. I did not use band_emissivity_contrast because the requirement is transmittance in one band and reflectance in another, not absorptance contrast between bands. No angle or polarization selectors are included since the user did not specify incidence angle or polarization state, implying normal incidence and unpolarized or default channel evaluation.
standard.formula_rationale: 用户对 1000-1700 nm 透射率和 300-450 nm 反射率均要求“尽可能”优化，未指定主次权重。两项指标均为 0 到 1 之间的分数，量级一致，直接相加可平等对待信号获取与背景抑制这两个核心需求。两项系数均为正，确保变量增大时总分升高，符合“最大化”方向，避免引入人为权重导致排名任意性。
